name: Rahel Eleanor Amethyst
source: Kind and gentle, Rahel does whatever she can to make Astrid's journey through Purgatory easier. She has made the best of her situation despite her loneliness, saying that she has discovered things while deceased that her contemporaries had never thought existed. While possessing a noticeably outdated vocabulary, Rahel's helpful and honest nature is evident when she speaks.
